Name: Midori's camping set for alternative textures (AT)
Author: mikitakrushev
Description:
[font=Times New Roman]Once upon a time in a far away land... , there was a village that stood up from the rest, its tradition with camping was special and one of a kind... ; this furniture set inspired by the cottagecore and fairycore aesthetics is designed to make the whimsical natural campsite site you envision, this mod is a content pack for alternative textures (AT), at the moment, this mod only provides 3 log textures for the birch bench, the log variations this mod currently is cempasúchil/marigold, lavender and amanita mushroom. There will be more items and textures in the future; if you use my mod, I would adore that you could share screenshots of your farm, the creativity in the Stardew Valley community is endless and it never stops surprising me, you can also suggest items you would love to see for this mod, maybe your ideas will be turn in some magical items... , tysm for taking a look at my mod, I really apreciate it.

Credits:
Midori Schmitz (Author)[/font]
[font=Times New Roman]Wildflour: for the screenshots you took to showcase the marigold and amanita mushroom logs and for guiding and giving me feedback for the making of this mod <3
Atlas: for giving me inspiration and ideas from their gorgeous furniture pack[/font]
[font=Times New Roman]TheLimeyDragon: for guiding me solve an issue with sitting in the back position of the bench
Yellog: for giving me inspiration and ideas from their mods
